question: In the kinetic model of CO2 capture by MEA and TEA in the microbubble study, what are the values of k1f for MEA and k3r for TEA?

[Evaluating CO2 Capture in Aqueous Amine Solution by Using a New Microbubble System, page 10]

parameter <k1f k1r k2f k2r k3f k3r k4f k4r value unit MEA 3.04 × 104 0.00 3.83 × 10−4 − 1.76 × 10−3 1.71 × 10−3 − 2.17 × 10−3 TEA 1.07−3.54 1.00 × 107 1.03 5.71 × 10−4 − 1.99 × 10−3
